title: SourceProfileAdapter
responsibility: Observes registered source operations in supported test runners while preserving call semantics, startup isolation and uninstrumented production builds.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Project root and registered unit manifests used to map realpaths of owned source files to eligible units. Only active units with a module target and a kind other than component, page, shell or layout are indexed, the fixed list of adapter and schema bootstrap ids is excluded, and a file owned by more than one eligible unit is never instrumented.

units.title: EvidenceLedger
units.responsibility: Appends verified evidence entries to the project ledger.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform.source
inputs.description: Original module source text handed to the transform; instrumentation only inserts an observer import and wrapper calls, so authored bodies, call order and evaluation count are unchanged. The text is inspected only when the id resolves to exactly one eligible owner.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform.id
inputs.description: Module address for the file: a file: URL, an /@fs/ path or a plain path with an optional query suffix, which is removed before the realpath lookup. Addresses that do not resolve to an existing file, resolve outside the project root or into node_modules, or do not end in .ts, .mts, .tsx, .js, .mjs or .jsx are not instrumented.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.source
inputs.description: Original module source text to inspect; the result keeps authored bodies, call order and evaluation count, and it is null when no supported call, method or initialization boundary exists.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.path
inputs.description: Absolute source filename passed to the TypeScript parser; its SHA-256 digest seeds the observer identifier, and initialization edits require it to end with one of the unit's owned source paths.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit whose owned source list, runtime module target, contract outputs and symbols decide which declarations are wrapped and which unit id and callable name each observation records.

examples.title: EvidenceLedger
examples.responsibility: Appends verified evidence entries to the project ledger.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.file
inputs.description: Parsed TypeScript source file whose top-level variable initializers must all be literal data and which must contain no functions or classes. Its file name must end with one of the unit's owned source paths for an initialization edit to be emitted.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit whose owned source paths and id define the initialize metadata; a unit with helper contracts or a bootstrap id produces no initialization edit.

examples.title: EvidenceLedger
examples.responsibility: Appends verified evidence entries to the project ledger.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.watch
inputs.description: Generated identifier base that names the Begin and Finish observer locals; instrumentSource derives it from the first 12 hex digits of the source path's SHA-256 digest and appends underscores until the source text does not contain it.

inputs.name: beginSourceScope.boundary
inputs.description: Registered unit, operation name and async boundary metadata for an initialization scope; the collector receives the unit, a SHA-256 digest of the operation and the callable name, and argument values and results are never captured.

inputs.name: watchOperation.args
inputs.description: Argument list of a call to the wrapped operation; the proxy forwards it unchanged and records no argument values.

inputs.name: watchMethod.owner
inputs.description: Object or prototype whose own method descriptor will be observed; only an own data property holding a function is replaced, and accessor properties are never evaluated.

inputs.name: watchMethod.name
inputs.description: Method property name selected on the supplied owner; names that are absent, accessors or not own function-valued data properties are skipped without replacement.

inputs.name: watchMethod.boundary
inputs.description: Registered unit, operation name and async boundary metadata for the replaced method; argument values and results are never captured.

inputs.name: sourceProfilePlugin.root
inputs.description: Project root whose realpath, specification/units registry and specification/scenarios manifest decide whether source profiling is selected; the plugin reads it only in Vite test mode.

inputs.name: runnerConfiguration.environment
inputs.description: Runner context whose profileRoot names the project for the test-mode observer; the observer installs nothing unless Vite runs in test mode and a profile is selected.

inputs.name: nativeProfilePlugins.root
inputs.description: Project root path passed as the Vite config root and as profileRoot for the test runner configuration; the loader uses it without validating it first.

inputs.name: profileSelection.root
inputs.description: Project root whose specification/units registry must exist and whose realpath becomes the selected root. A missing registry, no profile or evidence directory, or an explicit benchmark boundary yields null instead of an error.

inputs.name: profileEnvironment.root
inputs.description: Canonical selected project root that is written to HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_ROOT for the runner and its native children.

inputs.name: profileEnvironment.directory
inputs.description: Profile directory from HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR or the evidence directory, copied into the environment for immutable runtime capture chunks; the value is not created or checked here.

outputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform
outputs.description: Instrumented module text for the single eligible owner of the resolved id, or null when the id has no unique owner inside the project root, uses an unsupported extension, or has no supported observation boundary.

outputs.name: instrumentSource
outputs.description: Full source text after the observer import header and the wrapper or initialization edits are applied, or null when the module has no supported call, method or initialization boundary.

outputs.name: initializationEdits
outputs.type: { start: number; end: number; text: string; }[]
outputs.description: Ordered Edit objects that place the Begin call after any shebang and the Finish call at the end of the file, or an empty array when the module is not a data-only scope.

outputs.name: beginSourceScope
outputs.description: Finishing callback from the collector's beginScope when profiling is enabled, or a no-op when HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR is unset or a flush is running. A scope whose finish call never runs emits no successful observation.

outputs.name: watchOperation
outputs.description: Returns the operation unchanged when HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR is unset; otherwise a Proxy that keeps the receiver, arguments and return value, stops sampling after ten pending or successful calls, and stops sampling when a synchronous call returns a promise.

outputs.name: watchMethod
outputs.description: Installs watchOperation on the selected own method descriptor and returns nothing, leaving the property's writability, enumerability and configurability unchanged. It does nothing when the owner has no such own function-valued data property.

outputs.name: flushSourceProfiles
outputs.description: Flushes completed observations through the collector when HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR is set and no flush is already running, temporarily setting the evidence variables to that directory and restoring them afterwards. While a flush runs, watched operations and scopes bypass observation, which prevents recursive profiling of the collector.

outputs.name: sourceProfilePlugin
outputs.type: { name: string; enforce: "pre"; config(_config: unknown, environment: { mode: string; }): { test: { env: { HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_ROOT: string; HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR: string; HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_CONTEXT: string; BUN_OPTIONS: string; }; setupFiles: string[]; }; } | undefined; transform(source: string, id: string): { code: string; map: null; } | null; }
outputs.description: Vite plugin object for test-mode runs: its config hook assigns the profile environment to process.env, adds vitestSetup.ts and returns a test configuration, and its transform hook delegates to SourceProfileAdapter. The config hook returns nothing outside test mode or when no profile is selected.

outputs.name: runnerConfiguration
outputs.description: Vite configuration object whose only plugin is the source-profile plugin created for environment.profileRoot.

outputs.name: nativeProfilePlugins
outputs.description: Promise that resolves to the plugins of the runner configuration loaded in test mode, or to an empty array when HARNESS_COLLECT_FILES is set; it rejects when Vite loads no configuration.

outputs.name: profileSelection
outputs.type: { root: string; directory: string; units: ComponentManifest[] } | null
outputs.description: Canonical project root, selected profile directory and validated unit registry, or null outside an eligible evidence run or inside an explicit benchmark boundary. Each registry file is parsed with componentManifestSchema before it is returned.

units.title: EvidenceLedger
units.responsibility: Appends verified evidence entries to the project ledger.

outputs.name: profileEnvironment
outputs.type: { HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_ROOT: string; HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_DIR: string; HARNESS_RUNTIME_PROFILE_CONTEXT: string; BUN_OPTIONS: string; }
outputs.description: Environment object containing the canonical root, profile directory, runtime context (default standard-runner) and a single deduplicated --preload option for the bunPreload module.

errors.name: Source profile configuration or input failure
errors.description: Registry validation failures, unreadable registry or scenario files, failed Vite runner configuration loads and failed runner-module imports reject or throw; the adapter never substitutes observations for them. Bun preload load hooks also reject when a project source file cannot be read or transpiled.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Malformed JSON in a registry unit file or in a benchmark scenario manifest throws from profileSelection, so no profile is selected.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: The adapter constructor throws when units is not an array or an active unit lacks runtime.targets or owns.source, and watchMethod throws when its owner is null or undefined or its method is non-writable and non-configurable.

errors.name: ProfileRunnerConfigError
errors.description: Vite returned no source-profile runner configuration. Import and configuration-loading failures propagate.
